name: cumulative-scope-relies-on-layer-ord
body: `lint` and `model_errors` express the cumulative tier scope as `layer <= scope` over `Layer`'s derived catalog order (`Requirements < Domain < Solution < Plans < Implementation < Global`). Limit: the comparison silently admits Plans/Implementation/Global into scope if `--tier` ever accepts a value at or below them in that order; `parse_lint_args` currently refuses those values, so the ladder effectively stops at Solution. Upgrade to an explicit tier window (comparing only the three tier positions) if a wider `--tier` surface ever lands.
